beforeShellExecution.matcher: git remote set-url.*x-access-token|git remote.*github_pat_|git remote.*ghp_|x-access-token:.*git|git remote .*https://.*@|git config .*remote\.origin\.url.*(x-access-token|github_pat_|ghp_)

beforeSubmitPrompt.prompt: Keep replies concise unless the user asked for exhaustive detail. Do not paste huge files or long logs by default—summarize and cite slices. Secrets: never put GitHub PATs into git remote; use SSH deploy keys for host clones and op://GITHUB_TOKEN only for Docker/orchestrator.
